name: BLOOM 176B

release_date.note: model card 'Release Date Estimate'; the paper's arXiv v1 is 2022-11-09

params.note: model card; equals the count derived from config with tied embeddings

tokenizer.note: byte-level BPE; 200 of the stated tokens reserved

steps.label: 112 heads x 128, ALiBi bias on scores

specials.name: embedding_norm
specials.what: LayerNorm right after the token embedding (StableEmbedding), for training stability

specials.name: alibi
specials.what: per-head linear distance penalty added to attention scores; no position vectors

specials.name: tied_embeddings
specials.what: output head reuses the embedding table

paper.title: BLOOM: A 176B-Parameter Open-Access Multilingual Language Model
paper.note: section 3.2.3 (ALiBi, embedding LayerNorm), 3.3 (tokenizer, 250,680), Table 3; arXiv API: v1 2022-11-09

card.note: release date estimate 11 July 2022; 176,247,271,424 parameters, 3,596,615,680 embedding; RAIL v1.0; sequence length 2048

code.note: input_layernorm and post_attention_layernorm precede their sublayers; word_embeddings_layernorm; GELU via tanh formula; MLP width 4*hidden

figure_links.author: BigScience Workshop
figure_links.title: Figure 5 of the paper: the BLOOM architecture

unknowns.context_length.value: ALiBi model; config sets no position limit

notes: Paper and card state a 250,680-token vocabulary; config pads the embedding to 250,880 rows, and the card's embedding count (3,596,615,680 = 250,880 x 14,336) matches config. The record follows config.
